reply.text:
Sorry about the flu. Being sick is a good reason to miss a week, and it doesn't wipe out what you built. Good to have you back. We start from today.

Whenever you're cleared and feeling up to it, make the first session an easy one: lighter than you left off, a couple of sets short of your usual, and stop with plenty in the tank. Then add back volume and weight over a couple of weeks instead of trying to pick up where you stopped. A streak is just showing up week after week, so one session this week starts a new one.

If you'd like, I can set up a lighter session for today, or start your next planned workout.
